summary.text: Peri Pourier is a state representative from South Dakota's District 27, in office since 2019, who is running for the State Senate in District 27 as an independent.
Ballotpedia lists her opponents in the November 3, 2026, general election as Democrat Celestine Stadnick and Republican Anthony Kathol.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia reports that Pourier announced in September 2025 that she was leaving the Democratic Party and would register as a Republican.
She later ran for the South Dakota Public Utilities Commission and lost in the Republican convention on June 27, 2026.
Pourier is not running for re-election to the House, and in the 2025-2026 session she served on the House Judiciary, Military and Veterans' Affairs, and Taxation committees.
